tested_platform: Windows, Python 3.10.11, RTX 5070 Ti Laptop 12 GB, 32 GB RAM

checks.fresh_cuda13_install: passed after using official PyPI instead of an incomplete mirror
checks.generic_lora_patch: passed on a small synthetic unquantized MOSS model
checks.dynamic_compilation_generate_clear_switc: passed: compiled 8-step generation, clear caches, eager 8-step generation
checks.final_50_step_unload: passed; local service remained responsive after clearing model/execution caches

known_failures: Consecutive eager/compiled tests without clearing model and execution caches exhausted system memory during ordinary VAE decode.

Full-frame VAE decode failed with native memory allocation failure/access violation in inherited and fresh runtime 50-step tests. The bundled example uses standard tiled VAE decode; model/core code was not changed to hide this.

An earlier candidate forced a non-dynamic ModelPatcher and crashed during quantized model unload. Final code retains native dynamic model storage; generate/clear/switch/regenerate and post-50-step unload passed.
limitations: Single machine; no statistical speedup claim.
Actual quantized MOSS LoRA files and other GPU platforms are not validated.
Historical 89.19 s result predates standalone packaging and used a different decode workflow.
Third-party patches depending on the old internal RoPE layout need separate validation.
privacy: Package includes only source, safe example workflows, tools, notices and sanitized reports; runtime, models, user profiles, browser data and raw logs excluded.
